QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566`) ... installs its own calloc/free through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function installs itself through the setter. It never says this is the only in-tree caller, and it implies a project test config also installs hooks.
